steps.assertion: The Batch opens on the focused review surface
steps.text: Open **Expenses > Expense Batches** and choose your Batch. The summary at the top totals what you paid and what the company paid; the **Expenses** tab lists the lines.

steps.assertion: Shared analytics stay editable while the Batch is open
steps.text: Save the new analytic distribution under **Shared context**. Its existing expenses keep their current values until you apply the context.

steps.assertion: The context action explains its safe preview behavior
steps.text: Choose **Apply context to … expenses** to open the preview.

steps.assertion: The preview separates one change, one exception and one locked expense
steps.text: Review which drafts will change. Expenses already submitted or approved keep their values, as do drafts with their own allocation unless an authorized reviewer selects them for replacement.

steps.assertion: Confirm the update to the eligible draft
steps.text: Choose **Apply shared context** to update the eligible drafts.

steps.assertion: A real line exception has a compact, specific helper
steps.text: A line that differs from the Batch is marked with a short helper saying what differs. Open the line to align it, or leave it when the difference is intended.

steps.assertion: The expense list has no destructive trash control
steps.text: Nothing in the list deletes an expense.

steps.assertion: A draft can be detached from the Batch
steps.text: Use **Remove from Batch** on a draft to return it to your expense list. You can add it to another batch.

title: Review a Batch before submitting it
